reasoning: Identity confirmed (EO 11927, 1976-07-22, 41 FR 30583). The two-scope inventory is complete: sec. 1 changes level IV subsection (10) from Assistant to Counselor, and sec. 2 adds level V item (9), Deputy Assistant Secretary for Housing, HUD. Section 2 first ends on 1977-03-11, when EO 11976 sec. 2 deletes exactly that entry; no delayed effective date applies and no saving clause applies. Section 1: EO 12060 sec. 1 (1978-05-15) replaces 'Counselor to the Secretary for Congressional Affairs' in subsection (10) with 'Deputy Under Secretary for Regional Affairs'. Under the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling that replacement is a later event, and its quoted source carries both the old and the new text. Section 1 therefore continues, amended, until EO 12076 sec. 1-202 revokes EO 11861 as amended on 1978-08-18, with no delayed effective date. EO 12076 sec. 1-101(j) re-lists the position and sec. 1-201 preserves existing appointments. The whole-order end of 1978-08-18 equals the later first end. With the corrected dates, the structured fields now agree with the sources and with the claim's own reasons; the actor, mechanism, quotes and savings are correct.
